changelog:
**Expanded functionality and new lookup methods.**

- Added support for finding emails by LinkedIn profile URL and news article (author) URL, in addition to full name + company domain.
- Introduced new single and bulk endpoints for LinkedIn (`/find/linkedin/single` & `/find/linkedin/bulk`) and author (`/find/author/single` & `/find/author/bulk`) lookups.
- Added a "waterfall" single-find API option for direct, long-polling lookups with timeout.
- Improved documentation with detailed person object structure per method, optional parameters, paginated dump instructions, webhooks, credits, and error handling.
- Enhanced bulk and single lookup workflows, including progress polling and CSV export.
- Updated description and usage examples to reflect expanded multi-method support and new features.
